profile.description: National Gas and Industrialization Company engages in exploits, manufactures, and markets various kinds of gas and its derivatives, and industrial gases in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia and internationally. It manufactures, sells, and maintains cages, cylinders, tanks, and accessories; maintenance of gas networks and accessories; and manufactures, transports, and markets petroleum, chemical, and petrochemical and glass products. The company also establishes or participates in the production of energy, water treatment, and environmental services. In addition, it is involved in the establishment, building, and maintenance of liquefied petroleum gas (LPG) networks and tanks; and development of LPG products and solutions. Further, the company offers technical and engineering consulting services, and training related to gas and energy works; and acquires and invests in real estate, as well as purchases land for the construction of buildings for lease and sale. The company was founded in 1961 and is based in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
